people.name: Achzib
people.line: A town in Judah, birthplace of Shelah.

people.name: Bethlehem
people.line: City of David's birth and Jesus' birth.

people.name: Joash
people.line: A descendant of Shelah in the tribe of Judah

people.name: Jokim
people.line: A descendant of Judah through Shelah

people.name: Moab
people.line: Ancient kingdom east of the Dead Sea in Jordan

people.name: Saraph
people.line: Son of Shelah, descendant of Judah

translations.web: and Jokim, and the men of Cozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who had dominion in Moab, and Jashubilehem. These records are ancient.
translations.bsb: Jokim, the men of Cozeba, and Joash and Saraph, who ruled in Moab and Jashubi-lehem. (These names are from ancient records.)
translations.kjv: And Jokim, and the men of Chozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who had the dominion in Moab, and Jashubilehem. And these are ancient things.
translations.asv: and Jokim, and the men of Cozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who had dominion in Moab, and Jashubilehem. And the records are ancient.
